appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.description: If we rejected your listing, image, review or storefront change and you disagree, appeal from the rejected item. Our team reviews every appeal.

unavailable.title: Appeals are unavailable right now
unavailable.description: Please try again in a moment.

empty.title: No appeals yet
empty.description: You can appeal a rejection from the item that was rejected, using Appeal this decision.

appeals.followUp: Please resubmit the item for review; we will prioritise it.

button.label: Appeal this decision
button.sent: Appeal sent. Our team will review it and you will be notified of the outcome. <link>View your appeals</link>
button.hint: One appeal per decision. Be specific.

errors.reasonMin: Explain why the decision should change (at least 10 characters).
